events.title: Blast announces L2 wind-down affecting BlasterSwap's host chain
events.description: Blast announced an orderly wind-down of the L2 and asked users to withdraw assets to Ethereum. BlasterSwap is a Blast-native DEX, so the announcement creates a material host-chain shutdown dependency even though it does not by itself prove that BlasterSwap has already ceased operating.
events.notes: HEI does not assign BlasterSwap a death date from the Blast announcement alone. Final status should be rechecked when the Blast chain/interface shutdown becomes effective.
